 r,c=p

steps.input:
def reach_windows(text,n,src,goal,allowzero=True):
 g0=[list(map(int,row)) for row in text.split()]; R0=len(g0); C0=len(g0[0])
 def ok(p):
  r,c=p; vals=[g0[i][j] for i in range(r,r+n) for j in range(c,c+n)]
  if p==goal:return all(v in (1,2) for v in vals)
  return all(v in ((0,1) if allowzero else (1,)) for v in vals)
 valid={(r,c) for r in range(R0-n+1) for c in range(C0-n+1) if ok((r,c))}
 q=deque([src]); dist={src:0}; prev={src:None}
 while q:
  p=q.popleft()
  for v in ((p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)):
   if v in valid and v not in dist:dist[v]=dist[p]+1;prev[v]=p;q.append(v)
 return g0,valid,dist,prev
